terms.seniorPremium: +0.50% typical (varies slightly by tenure — compare the General Public and Senior Citizen columns for the exact slab)
terms.superSeniorPremium: +0.75% over general public on non-callable deposits (age 80+); staff +1%, senior-ex-staff +1.50%, super-senior-ex-staff +1.75% (non-callable scheme only, not modelled as separate rows here — see the bank's page)
terms.prematurePenalty: 1% flat on premature withdrawal (no penalty if renewed for a longer period); non-callable deposits generally disallow premature withdrawal
